summary.text: Jack McEntire is a Democratic candidate for the Washington House of Representatives, District 15-Position 1, in the November 3, 2026 general election, in which he faces incumbent Chris Corry (R).
He was also the Democratic candidate for this seat in 2018 and 2020, losing both times to Bruce Chandler.

paragraphs.text: Jack McEntire ran for District 15-Position 1 in 2018, when he lost the general election to incumbent Bruce Chandler, receiving 40.3 percent of the vote.
He ran again in 2020 and lost to Chandler, 58.0 percent to 41.9 percent.
In the August 4, 2026 primary for the seat, McEntire received 32.9 percent of the vote and Corry received 66.9 percent.
